name: dunkers
caption:
CHOOSE YOUR STARTER: DUNK CONTEST 🎮🏀 One dunk contest, one of our guys. Who are you sending?

1️⃣ Vince Carter: 2000 Dunk Contest champ, Air Canada himself
2️⃣ Terrence Ross: 2013 Dunk Contest champ as a rookie
3️⃣ DeMar DeRozan: 2010 Dunk Contest finalist, our all-time leading scorer

Comment 1, 2 or 3 👇

facts.claim: Vince Carter won the 2000 Slam Dunk Contest and 1999 Rookie of the Year; nicknamed Air Canada; No. 15 retired by Toronto; wore #15 for Toronto 1998-2004
Terrence Ross won the 2013 Slam Dunk Contest as a rookie, scored 51 points in a game (Jan 25, 2014), was drafted #8 overall in 2012, wore #31 for Toronto 2012-2017
DeMar DeRozan lost in the final round of the 2010 Slam Dunk Contest; the Raptors' #1 all-time leading scorer; 9 seasons in Toronto (2009-2018); wore #10
Jersey numbers: Ross 31, DeRozan 10, Carter 15 with Toronto
